reason: I already go out most weeks and I hate finding out about a concert two days after tickets went up on some story I missed. If it is really all in one place with no extra fee, I would download it tonight and probably buy one ticket this month, if something I actually want is on.
objection: My friends decide where we go, not an app, so unless they are on it too I will still end up wherever the group chat says. And I do not believe the feed will really be complete, every app in Tirana promises that and then half the events are missing or the dates are wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Nothing to flip me on downloading since it is free, but to keep buying through it I would need to see who else is going actually work, my friends on it, and the feed to really have everything, not just the organizers who signed up.
